The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 07b4a3f530849ff7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix S. For all sufficiently large β there are Cβ, R0(β) < ∞ with the following property. Let L be even, let R0(β) ≤ R ≤ L, and partition ΛL into rectangular cells whose side lengths belong to [R/2, 4R]. For every deterministic real f : ΛL → [−1, 1] with P x∈B fx = 0 on each cell B, put Df = X x fxZx, q = R−5/2 , w = 1 − q = e−b . If ⟨·⟩b is the Gibbs expectation with exponent H0 + b P x Yx, then q V ⟨D2 f ⟩b ≤ CβR−1/40 . (4.1) The constants are uniform in the partition, f, and L.
